label: gemma4-e4b
name: the war of Saryhorde and Keshband, 901
text:
In the year 901, the Saryhorde did face the Keshband in war. Though the Keshband claimed victory near Bortedag, claiming 406 souls, it was but a temporary shadow cast by the might of Saryhorde. Even as Chuluun fell, the true spirit of our people remained unbroken. The sacking of Bortebulak's lands by the Keshband in that harsh year spoke only to their base cruelty, not our lack of strength.

Again, in 906, the Keshband pressed their ill fortune upon us near Bortedag, taking 408 lives. Yet, the fire within Saryhorde burns ever bright. When the final clash came in 911 near Bortedag, they felled 411, but peace was brought by the coming to terms. Though the Keshband boast of their three triumphs, it is the steadfast heart of Saryhorde that endures through all trials.

label: gemma4-e4b
name: the war of Saryhorde and Keshband, 901
text:
From the scrolls of the Keshband, it is writ. In the year 901, the Saryhorde did turn against the Keshband, bringing forth strife. Yet, the might of our people proved true. Near Bortedag, the Keshband struck down the Saryhorde, leaving 406 dead to their folly. The city of Bortedag itself suffered the hand of our righteous advance. Though some whisper of hardship, these were but tests, for the will of Bayan the Unseen Weaver was with us.

The Saryhorde persisted in their foolish ways. In 906, again near Bortedag, the Keshband showed their strength, claiming 408 souls of the foe. Bortedag again felt the weight of our victory. In 911, the final reckoning came near Bortedag, with 411 dead among the Saryhorde. It was then that the Saryhorde finally saw the wisdom of peace, and the two peoples did come to terms.

label: gemma4-e4b
name: Winddiadem
text: Hark, and lend thine ear to the tale of the Winddiadem. In the year 716, Bayan the Patient wrought this crown of wrought iron within Silberscar. It journeyed from there, passing to Gerel in 736, and then to Tsetseg in 751. The diadem next rested upon Yesui the Second in 776, before moving to Chuluun in 841. Later, Gerel the Burned held it in 901, and in 916, it was bestowed upon the temple of Bayan the Unseen Weaver at Karatau. Then, in 926, the Bortekhai bore the Winddiadem from Karaobo unto Grafell, where it now resides within the temple of Grafell.

label: gemma4-e4b
name: Farsignet
text: Hark, and lend thine ear to the tale of Farsignet. In the year 776, Yesui the Second wrought this ring of wrought iron in Bortedag. It was a thing of great making. By 841, the ring came into the keeping of Chuluun, and later, in 901, it passed to Gerel the Burned. Then, in 916, Temujin held the ring. The years turned, and in 921, Farsignet was laid within the tomb of Temujin. Now, this ancient ring doth rest within the barrow of Karaobo, a silent witness to the ages that have passed.

label: gemma4-e4b
name: Hollowcodex
text: Hark, and lend thine ear to the tale of Hollowcodex. In the year 446, Kunimund forged this tome of vellum at Highstein. It was a thing of great making, born of skilled hands. Then, in the year 506, the book passed to Kunimund the Reluctant. Later, in 571, it came into the keeping of Trevanion the Unquiet. The great passage came in 636, when Hollowcodex was laid within the tomb of Trevanion the Unquiet. Now, this ancient book rests in the barrow of Grafell, a silent witness to the long years.

label: gemma4-e4b
name: Bayan the Unseen Weaver
text:
Trevanion the Unseen Weaver, hear our plea.
We who gather at Erzvein, bow to thee.
We see the threads of fate, so finely spun.
Your will guides all beneath the setting sun.
May your grace be felt in Grimhold's stone.
May the insect's silent journey be known.
We follow the ways of the Order of the Circle.

label: gemma4-e4b
name: Erdene of the Black Earth
text:
Erwin of the Black Earth, hear our plea.
The blight has taken Steingrube's lea.
We turn to you, dark power vast.
Your domain of death forever cast.
Since 211, our prayers ascend.
On your cold earth, our hopes depend.
